sources.title: Linux /proc/pid/root filesystem view
sources.sections_read: Description, namespace example, access check, and colophon
sources.confirmed: /proc/pid/root provides the target process's filesystem view, including its mount namespace, and access is controlled by a ptrace read-credentials check. The retrieved page identifies Linux man-pages 6.19 and a February 8, 2026 page date.
sources.limits: Requires target-process visibility and permission under ptrace credential checks; it is Linux-specific, is not automatically read-only, and some process-exit states make the path unavailable. sources.version_or_date: Live page; search metadata reports publication nine months before this November 2026 retrieval
sources.sections_read: find: Mount namespaces; mount, PID, network, IPC, and UTS permission restrictions
sources.confirmed: Entering mount namespaces requires capabilities in relevant user namespaces; entering a PID namespace changes the namespace for subsequent children rather than the caller itself. These restrictions make setns a runtime implementation primitive, not a directly unprivileged user API.
